title: update

goal.text: Update claw-kit on the DSH host to the latest published CLI and adapter.

requirements.summary: Refresh the global claw CLI and the @veewo/dsh-claw-kit profile plugin as one update unit, then verify activation.
acceptanceCriteria: The installed claw CLI is the target version and accepts --host dsh.
The DSH profile bundles @veewo/dsh-claw-kit at the target version.
After the Host restart the claw_run tool and the seven bundled skills are present.

tasks.title: Detect the current and target versions
tasks.detail: Run claw --version and read the installed adapter version (dsh --profile <name> --dump-config / profile package.json). Resolve the latest published @veewo/claw and @veewo/dsh-claw-kit versions from the npm registry.

tasks.title: Update the global claw CLI
tasks.detail: npm install -g @veewo/claw@latest; confirm claw --version matches the target and that `claw context --host dsh` parses (the CLI must support the dsh host).

tasks.title: Update the DSH adapter in the profile
tasks.detail: dsh plugin --profile <name> add @veewo/dsh-claw-kit@latest; confirm the profile bundles list carries @veewo/dsh-claw-kit and dsh --profile <name> --dump-config shows the claw-kit row.

tasks.title: Restart the Host and verify activation
tasks.detail: Restart the DSH Host (dsh --profile <name>), then verify the claw_run tool is present and the seven bundled skills (using-claw-kit/researcher/planning/config/create-claw-skill/claw-kit-doc/update) are available; optionally run a plan.create smoke check.

rules: Never use unpublished workspace files as the update source.
CLI and adapter are one validation unit; do not report success until both are verified.
A new package version is not activation proof; require a real session with claw_run.
